verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable platform with a CLI and SDKs, but the evidence pack never documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control. The OpenMetrics export of the user's own metrics and the self-hosting option are adjacent features, not an opt-out of vendor telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
